crash.title: Uh-oh!
texts:
Tell us something about what you were doing when QGIS crashed.
Please include as much information as you can, as well as any steps we can follow to reproduce the issue, if possible.

Oh dear! Something unexpected happened and QGIS ended without being able to handle the error gracefully.

Are you keen to help us fix bugs? QGIS relies on donations to pay developers to do funded bug fixing to improve the stability of the software. We also have a team of enthusiastic volunteers who are all working hard to improve the quality of QGIS. To do that, we need your help. Find out how to help our developers.

Send us a helpful bug report by using the 'Copy Report' button below, 
then open a ticket on the QGIS Issue Tracker.
report: **Crash ID**: [ID not generated due to missing information.
Your version of QGIS install might not have debug information included or we couldn't get crash information.](https://github.com/qgis/QGIS/search?q=ID not generated due to missing information.
